messages:
samir: Quick intake — customer (FinData) asked to evaluate Kestrel-16B for hosted + dedicated on Redwood. They want latency ~<50ms/token tail for seq512 and a pricing estimate for INT8 quantized offering. Can someone own triage?

marta: I can take primary for model quality/evals. What's their priority?

samir: P1 for Q1 launch if evals look good. They gave some test prompts (financial summarization + few-shot Q&A).

zane: I can look at infra & memory footprint. Do we have a Kestrel repo or base checkpoint yet?

samir: They supplied an FP16 hf checkpoint link in the ticket. I'll DM the link.

jiang: Heads up — 16B fp16 baseline on A100 (1x) we should expect ~35-60ms per token at seq=512 depending on kernels and batching. INT8 quant may cut memory but watch for quality regressions on numerics.

marta: Proposed eval plan:
- baseline: FP16 greedy + temp=0.0 on provided prompt set (n=200)
- quant: PTQ 8-bit (GPTQ/NNI) + int8-mean-merge checks
- metrics: rouge/bleu where applicable, numeric fidelity (RMSE on numeric extraction), hallucination rate, and token-level latency/throughput
- failure cases: long-context consistency (seq 2k) and finance terms recall

samir: also need perf checklist for Dedicated (autoscale, fallback to hosted-small model).

zane: infra checklist items:
- model size (FP16) -> estimate GPU memory + KV cache for seq512
- recommended GPUs (A10x, A100, H100?)
- batching profile (target p99 latency)
- quant profile: which kernels supported on our runtime for int8

marta: quick numbers from a micro test I ran (single A100, batch=1, seq=512):
```
fp16 = 42 ms/token (sample run, greedy)
mem_fp16_model = ~38GB
kv_cache_seq512 = ~8GB
```
INT8 tentative mem_model ~= 20GB but quality TBD.

eva: FYI the customer emphasized determinism and numeric accuracy (end-of-month summaries). If INT8 causes small drift we might need hybrid (fp16 weights for critical layers).

jiang: Agree. Suggest we try 8-bit on MLP-only or attention-only layers first, and run numeric tests. I can spin a quant experiment pipeline this afternoon.

marta: I'll start the eval harness. Can someone create an eval dataset folder with the 200 prompts and expected numeric outputs? @eva can you drop the file here or in the ticket?

eva: Uploading now to the ticket. Filename: fin-summ-200.csv.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-8321 created for Kestrel-16B onboarding (assignee: marta). SLA: 7d for initial smoke.

samir: Rough rollout plan:
1) run baseline eval (marta) + perf microbench (zane) — 2 days
2) try PTQ int8 experiments (jiang) — 2 days
3) review quality regressions + decide hybrid quant threshold (marta/ev a) — 1 day
4) Dedicated sizing and price estimate (zane) — 1 day
5) canary deploy with fallback to FP16 small model — ops check

marta: Quick checklist I'm adding to the ticket (copying here):
- [ ] confirm model license & export constraints
- [ ] run n=200 baseline evals and produce metrics.csv
- [ ] run numeric fidelity tests (RMSE, percent-change)
- [ ] run long-context checks (seq 2048)
- [ ] run PTQ int8 experiments and collect quality deltas
- [ ] find hybrid quant config if delta > 1.5% on numeric metric
- [ ] perf microbench (latency p50/p95/p99, throughput)
- [ ] infra recommendation (gpu type & slot sizing)
- [ ] estimate cost delta INT8 vs FP16 per 1k tokens
- [ ] schedule canary window and rollback plan

zane: For cost estimate I'll assume H100 pricing for dedicated baseline and factor 30-40% cost reduction for INT8 memory reductions -> better packing.

jiang: I'll push a quick PTQ run on a snapshot and post results. Expect first numbers in ~6 hours.

eva: Customer asks about embed support (we use Kestrel for generation only) — can you confirm whether we'll expose text-embedding-ada endpoints or not?

marta: Not in scope for initial ask, note captured.

samir: Thanks all. If we find major regression (>3% RMSE) we escalate to product and discuss delaying dedicated. Otherwise proceed.

marta: Aiming to post first eval summary by EOD tomorrow.

jiang: PTQ run complete initial pass: int8 PTQ yields ~1.1% RMSE on numeric extracts, fp16->int8 latency improved ~1.9x in the microbench. P95 latency reduced from 220ms -> 120ms (seq512, batch1). Will upload logs.

marta: Nice. Can you attach sample outputs for cases where numbers diverged?

jiang: Uploaded results and a short diff file: /tickets/INF-8321/artifacts/ptq-diff.txt

samir: Good progress. Next: marta will synthesize quality + perf and zane will deliver sizing/pricing. We'll reconvene tomorrow at 11am for go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled with channel eng-ml at 2024-08-03T11:00:00Z.
